Defaults: Fixed mode · max 40 · zoom base 40 · multiplier 1.2 · adaptive rounds 8 · cap 4096
Default: 40 (range 10–4096). Used as the only cap in Fixed, or pass-1 base in Adaptive.
Default: 8 (range 1–16). Each round may double the iteration limit on border pixels.
Default: 4096 (range 10–4096). Hard ceiling across adaptive rounds.

Fixed mode uses the same max iterations at every zoom (default 40).

Scale with zoom starts at the base value at the home view (default base 40, multiplier 1.2). Each doubling of zoom multiplies max iterations by the multiplier. Values are clamped between 10 and 4096.

Adaptive mode renders pass 1 at the Fixed max (or at the max carried from the previous bitmap border refine after zoom), then only re-tests interior border pixels (next to escaped neighbors). At each doubled limit it keeps filling the border until a full pass finds no new escapes, then doubles again (or stops if that first pass found nothing). Intermediate border fills are shown on screen.

Navigating the fractal

• Pan — drag with one finger. A live preview follows your finger; the full render finishes after you lift.

• Pinch zoom — use two fingers. Zoom stays anchored on the midpoint between your fingers. The zoom commits when you lift the last finger.

• Double-tap — zoom in on the tapped point.

• Long-press — show complex coordinates under your finger; lift to dismiss.

Bottom bar (HUD)

• + / − — zoom in or out about the screen center.
• Reset — return to the initial viewport.
• Smooth — toggle continuous iteration coloring (icon highlighted when on).
• ☰ Menu — formula, palette, export, iterations, help, and about.

Iterations

Menu → Iterations chooses Fixed max (default 40), Scale with zoom (base 40, multiplier 1.2), or Adaptive border refine (pass-1 at Fixed max, then double the limit on ambiguous border pixels).

Status overlay

The top-left panel shows the current formula, palette, smooth setting, and effective iteration cap. Tap to hide; tap ··· to show again.

Render progress

After you lift your finger, a thin bar at the top fills while the fractal re-renders (steps 8→4→2→1). It hides when the frame is ready or when a new gesture starts.

Export

Menu → Export → Share or Save to gallery. Captures the fractal view only.

Privacy

No network, ads, or analytics. Everything runs on your device.
